scope: qualification-only; not a runtime API contract

cases.purpose: Measure prompt adherence and create the preserved comparison image.
cases.prompt: A cinematic night illustration of one adult woman in a bright red coat standing to the left of one blue motorcycle on a wet city street, one full moon visible, no readable text.

cases.purpose: Prove a warm second iteration without model-file reload.
cases.revision: Keep the composition, subject, motorcycle, lighting, camera and seed unchanged; change only the coat from bright red to emerald green.
